quotes.name: Martin Richards
quotes.quote: Honestly, I've been trying to process everything that's been happening, and it's hard to put into words. As someone who's lived in Fruitvale for a while, I feel like I'm still trying to make sense of it all. I've seen the city come together in ways that feel really meaningful, but at the same time, I'm still trying to figure out my own place in it.
